_comment: The one source of the core routers' hosts (ingressroutes-core.yaml) and the apps' bounds the CLI writes into portcullis-admission-params: reservedHosts = the apex + <subdomain>.<domain> for each subdomain, maxAppPriority (below every core route's effective priority: its own, else Traefik's default len(rule)). tests/k8s_hardening.py holds the rendered core IngressRoutes to both.
